categories.name: Ignoring Tool/Search Results
categories.definition: Failing to use or correctly read data actually returned by tools (flights, prices, passenger names/DOB, reservation cabin, membership, durations/arrival times), instead relying on assumptions, stale data, or fabricated options.
categories.boundary: Distinct from policy misunderstanding: the information was present in tool output but overlooked or misread.

categories.name: Misapplying Policy or Business Rules
categories.definition: Incorrectly interpreting or applying stated policies (modify vs cancel/rebook, certificate/gift-card refund and usage limits, basic economy cabin changes, 24-hour cancellation, insurance/health cancellation, partially-flown flights, upgrade-then-cancel).
categories.boundary: Distinct from ignoring tool results: here the data is known but the governing rule is misapplied.

categories.name: Payment Method or Refund Error
categories.definition: Choosing the wrong payment method, misapplying certificates/gift cards (e.g., passing full stored amount instead of exact fare), splitting payment incorrectly, or refunding to the wrong method.
categories.boundary: Distinct from generic policy errors by centering on payment/refund selection and split logic.

categories.name: Wrong Flight or Fare Selection
categories.definition: Selecting a non-cheapest, invalid, stale, or non-optimal flight, routing, fare, date, or upgrade target versus search results or user requirements, or failing to search a valid alternative (one-stop/nonstop).
categories.boundary: Distinct from route/destination and modification issues; concerns picking the wrong itinerary instance, fare, date, or search coverage.

categories.name: Incorrect Itinerary Modification or Reservation Selection
categories.definition: Acting on the wrong reservation object or the wrong passenger's reservation, misidentifying duplicates, or cancelling/modifying reservations not in the intended set while leaving the correct ones untouched.
categories.boundary: Distinct from cancel-eligibility judgments; concerns which reservation/action target is chosen.

categories.name: Failed Execution or Premature Termination
categories.definition: Not executing approved/correct actions (exhausting steps on endless confirmation before the required tool call, transferring to a human) when the right action was already determined.
categories.boundary: Distinct from planning errors; the agent knew enough or could trivially act but did not perform the required tool calls.

categories.name: Procedure Non-Compliance (Verification/Consent)
categories.definition: Proceeding with cancellation, charging, or changes without required verification of eligibility, refund method, flight status, consent, or budget; or skipping the retrieval of reservation details needed to judge eligibility.
categories.boundary: Distinct from policy misunderstanding; the governing requirement was knowable but the verification check was skipped.

categories.name: Incorrect Arithmetic or Data Calculation
categories.definition: Miscalculating fees, totals, baggage allowances, price differences, refunds, or payment amounts, leading to wrong charges or decisions.
categories.boundary: Distinct from ignoring results; involves using correct data but computing the wrong value.

categories.name: Overlooking User Communication or Preferences
categories.definition: Ignoring or contradicting explicit user instructions/preferences about cancellation scope, payment, routing openness, refunds, baggage, booking identity, or how to proceed.
categories.boundary: Distinct from policy misapplication; the failure is against the user's own stated wishes rather than a rule.

categories.name: Wrong Passenger/Profile or Booking-User Data Usage
categories.definition: Using the wrong passenger DOB, membership status, saved passenger, or booking-user identity from profile/tool results, causing booking or fee errors.
categories.boundary: Distinct from generic ignoring-tool-results; specifically about which person's attributes are applied to eligibility, fees, and account tie.

categories.name: Incorrect Baggage Entitlement
categories.definition: Misapplying free-bag allowance rules based on membership status, cabin, or insurance, especially trusting a stale/incorrect membership value over the correct one.
categories.boundary: Distinct from arithmetic errors; the allowance rule itself is misapplied rather than a calculation mistake.

categories.name: Incorrect Cancellation/Refund Eligibility Judgment
categories.definition: Wrongly deciding a reservation can or cannot be cancelled, refunded, or upgraded-then-cancelled based on cabin class, insurance coverage, business-class status, flight status, or reason type, leading to wrongful cancellation or denial.
categories.boundary: Distinct from generic policy misapplication and reservation selection; centers on whether a specific reservation is eligible at all and acting on that judgment.
